macOS 下请用 Homebrew 安装，phpvm 会自动发现已安装的 ke:
On macOS, install via Homebrew and phpvm will auto-discover installed kegs:

  brew install php@8.1        # example: PHP 8.1
  brew install php@7.4 php@5.6

Once installed, come back to this page and click "Refresh" to see the new version.
You may also drop official binaries into ~/wnrp/phpNN/ (including bin/php-cgi) and refresh.
